## Checklist
- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<issue>-<short-description>`
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (e.g. `feat(reminders): add snooze (#12)`)
- [ ] Tested in Expo Go or the emulator against the local backend
- [ ] Accessibility: 18pt+ text, 4.5:1 contrast, 48px targets, max 2 taps
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files or real patient data committed
- [ ] AI-generated code? If yes, say where: ________
- [ ] Safety-critical change? If yes, `safety-critical` label added and both teammates requested as reviewers
